title: PinPoint: Evaluation of Composed Image Retrieval with Explicit Negatives, Multi-Image Queries, and Paraphrase Testing

bias_targets.methodology: Annotation of query images containing people with the Monk Skin Tone (MST) scale to characterize dataset distribution and enable subgroup fairness analyses.
Evaluating and comparing retrieval performance across 23 diverse visual domains (e.g., Fashion, Home Decor, Beauty) to ensure equitable performance across different categories.
